findings.title: `reasoning_effort` rejects "minimal", a value GPT-5 supports.
findings.body:
The linked issue asks for `reasoning_effort` to work with GPT-5 models. GPT-5 accepts `"minimal"`, and the PR description says the Literal includes it. Both the Pydantic field here and the `CreateArguments` TypedDict (line 53) allow only `"low" | "medium" | "high"`.

A config such as `{"reasoning_effort": "minimal"}` loaded through `ChatCompletionClient.load_component` raises a `ValidationError`. Constructing the client directly with that value is a type error.

Fix: add `"minimal"` to both Literals, and to the valid values in `test_reasoning_effort_validation`.
